title: Estée Lauder names Executive Director, Global Communications, Make-up Brands to drive ‘relevance’
summary: Rachele Testa Schaefers has joined Estée Lauder Companies as Executive Director, Global Communications, Make-up Brands to lead ‘a social-first, culture-led’ strategy for the portfolio, including MAC Cosmetics and Bobbi Brown Cosmetics
